label.en: App Store: WePlay - 線上桌遊吧 (developer website on weplayapp.com)

label.zh-TW: WePlay 官網：未成年人保護

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結。分享文案沒有邀請碼，連結會轉到 WePlay 官方網域上的 PK 邀請頁。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link. The share text has no code, and the link leads to a PK invitation page on WePlay's official domain.

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 WePlay，並註冊或登入；請只從 App Store、Google Play 或官網 weplayapp.com 連結的官方上架頁下載。
steps.en: Follow the page to download WePlay, then register or log in; download only from the App Store, Google Play or the listings linked from weplayapp.com.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊時需要填寫生日。平台以 13 歲為最低年齡，未滿 18 歲須經家長或法定監護人同意，台灣 App Store 分級為 16+，請先確認自己符合條件。
steps.en: Registration asks for your birthday. Minimum age 13 (higher where local law requires); under-18s need a parent's or guardian's consent; App Store rating 16+.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊時是否帶入邀請人沒有測試過；若沒有，請回到本頁重新開啟連結，實際規則以 WePlay 官方說明為準。
steps.en: Whether the referrer is applied at sign-up was not tested; if not, reopen the link from this page.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請人的 PK 邀請連結開啟 WePlay，一款可語音聊天的派對遊戲 App；沒有列出邀請碼與獎勵。
intro.en: Open WePlay, a party-game app with voice chat, via the referrer's PK invite link. No code or reward listed.

description.zh-TW:
WePlay 是由新加坡 WEJOY PTE. LTD. 營運的派對遊戲與語音聊天 App，可以和其他玩家一起玩多人遊戲。App 可免費下載，站內另有金幣儲值與 VIP 訂閱等需要付費的項目。

這是邀請人專屬的邀請連結，來自 WePlay 的分享功能，使用 weplay.run 短網址，沒有另外的邀請碼，分享文案也沒有提到獎勵，所以本頁不列出優惠。

語音聊天的對象包含陌生人。依官方服務條款，服務不適用於未滿 13 歲者（當地法律另有較高年齡規定者從其規定），未滿 18 歲須經父母或法定監護人同意；台灣 App Store 的年齡分級為 16+。
description.en:
WePlay is a party-game and voice-chat app operated by WEJOY PTE. LTD. in Singapore, where you can play multiplayer games with other players. The app is free to download, and in-app purchases include coins and a VIP subscription.

This is the referrer's personal invite link, produced by WePlay's share function as a short link on weplay.run. There is no separate invite code, and the share text mentions no reward, so no offer is listed here.

Voice chat can put you in touch with strangers. Under the official terms of service the app is not for children under 13 (or a higher age where local law requires), people under 18 need a parent's or guardian's consent, and the Taiwan App Store rating is 16+.

notes.zh-TW:
這是邀請人專屬連結（短網址 weplay.run 的個人路徑），網址原樣保留，分享文案沒有提供邀請碼。2026-10-24 維運者用瀏覽器開啟分享連結，轉到 WePlay 官方網域的邀請頁（static-h5.weplayapp.com 的 invite-newbie-share，邀請人代碼在轉址後的網址參數中）。註冊時邀請關係是否被平台接受，沒有測試。

分享文案沒有提到獎勵，所以不列出優惠，本站也沒有找到官方的邀請獎勵說明；平台也可能隨時調整規則。本站查閱的官方服務條款沒有找到邀請連結或邀請獎勵的相關規定，但條款第 8 條禁止未經授權的商業用途與廣告，本站無法確認條款是否允許第三方網站公開推廣個人邀請連結。

網域：weplay.run 是 WePlay 邀請連結使用的短網址網域。2026-10-24 檢查時，根網址會轉到官網 weplayapp.com，個人連結則轉到 weplayapp.com 的子網域。本站沒有取得網域登記資料，查閱的 weplayapp.com 頁面也沒有提到 weplay.run，只以這些轉址行為，以及連結來自 WePlay 自己的分享功能作為依據。

年齡與安全：這是會與陌生人語音聊天的服務。官方服務條款（2026-07-16 更新）說明，服務不適用於未滿 13 歲者，當地法律另有較高年齡規定者從其規定；未滿 18 歲或未達當地成年年齡者須經父母或法定監護人同意。台灣 App Store 的年齡分級為 16+，標示的內容包含暗示性主題、訊息與聊天、使用者產生內容，以及轉蛋（loot boxes）類機制。官方的未成年人保護說明提到，註冊需填寫生日，且未成年與成年使用者的語音房分開。若在語音房被要求轉到其他通訊軟體或付款，請提高警覺。

付費項目：App 內可購買金幣（台灣 App Store 標示的單筆價格最高為 NT$1,990）與活動禮包，另有連續訂閱的 VIP，都是實際花費。官方服務條款（第 13 條）說明虛擬物品沒有貨幣價值，不能兌換為現金、商品或服務；本站也不保證任何收益；建議為未成年使用者設定購買限制。

短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en:
This is the referrer's personal link (a personal path on the weplay.run short-link domain); the address is kept exactly as shared, and the share text gives no invite code. On 2026-10-24 the maintainer opened the share link in a browser: it redirected to an invitation page on WePlay's official domain (invite-newbie-share on static-h5.weplayapp.com, with the referrer's code in the address parameters after the redirect). Whether the platform accepts the referral at sign-up was not tested.

The share text mentions no reward, so no offer is listed, and no official invite reward description was found; the platform may change its rules at any time. The official terms of service this site read contain no provision about invite links or invite rewards, but section 8 prohibits unauthorized commercial use and advertising, and it could not be confirmed whether the terms allow third-party sites to promote personal invite links publicly.

Domain: weplay.run is the short-link domain used by WePlay invite links. When checked on 2026-10-24, the root address redirected to the official site weplayapp.com and the personal link redirected to a subdomain of weplayapp.com. Registry data for the domain was not retrieved, and the weplayapp.com pages this site read do not mention weplay.run, so this site relies only on those redirects and on the link coming from WePlay's own share function.

Age and safety: this is a service with voice chat among strangers. The official terms of service (updated 2026-07-16) say the service is not for children under 13, or a higher age where local law requires, and that people under 18 or below the local age of majority may use it only with a parent's or guardian's consent. The Taiwan App Store rating is 16+, with content descriptors for suggestive themes, messaging and chat, user-generated content and loot-box style mechanics (gacha). The official minor-protection page says registration requires a birthday and minors' and adults' voice rooms are separated. Be wary if you are asked in a voice room to move to another messaging app or to pay.

Paid items: the app sells coins (the Taiwan App Store lists single prices up to NT$1,990) and event packs, plus an auto-renewing VIP subscription, and all of them cost real money. The official terms of service (section 13) say virtual items have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash, goods or services, and this site does not promise any earnings either; setting purchase limits for minors is advisable.

The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: WePlay 的邀請連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need to enter an invite code for the WePlay invite link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要。分享文案沒有提供邀請碼。2026-10-24 開啟分享連結時，會先轉到 WePlay 官方網域 static-h5.weplayapp.com 的邀請頁，邀請人資訊在轉址後的網址參數中，所以請直接透過本頁連結開啟。
a.en: No. The share text provides no code. When the share link was opened on 2026-10-24, it redirected to an invitation page on WePlay's official domain static-h5.weplayapp.com, with the referrer's details in the address parameters, so open the link on this page directly.

q.zh-TW: 使用這條 WePlay 邀請連結有獎勵嗎？
q.en: Does the WePlay invite link come with a reward?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只是遊戲邀請，沒有提到邀請人或被邀請人的獎勵，開啟邀請頁時也沒有看到獎勵說明，所以本頁不列出優惠。是否有獎勵、誰能領取與條件，以註冊畫面與 WePlay 官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text is just a game invitation and mentions no reward for the referrer or the invited person, and the invitation page showed no reward description when it was opened, so no offer is listed. Whether any reward exists, who receives it and under what conditions follow the sign-up screens and WePlay's official announcements.
